SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.student_id AS studentId, st.student_name AS studentName, st.grade_key AS gradeKey, cd.codeNm AS gradeName, COALESCE(dia.record_time, CAST(si.seq AS VARCHAR(2))) AS timeSlot,
cs.session_id AS sessionId, cs.status AS sessionStatus, dia.diary_key AS diaryKey,
-- 108 = hh:mi:ss → VARCHAR(5)로 자르면 "HH:mm" (화면 입력칸 포맷과 동일) CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), COALESCE(dia.in_time, cs.entered_at), 108) AS inTime, CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), COALESCE(dia.out_time, cs.exited_at), 108) AS outTime,
-- 도움 필요는 그날 일지에 기록된 스냅샷을 우선 보여준다(과거 날짜를 조회하면 그때의 값). -- 일지가 아직 없는 행은 현재 학생 상태값으로 채운다 — 예약을 깔고 일지로 덮는 이 화면의 정책과 같다. COALESCE(dia.help_needed, st.help_needed) AS helpNeeded, dia.memo AS memo, dia.is_send AS isSend, -- 전송 버튼 아이콘 판별용 — 앱 미가입(토큰 없음/빈 문자열)이면 발송 자체가 불가하다 CAST(CASE WHEN NULLIF(st.app_token, '') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS BIT) AS hasAppToken, att.attitudeCodes AS attitudeCodesRaw FROM erp_bookstore_reservation r JOIN erp_bookstore_slot_instance si ON si.slot_instance_id = r.slot_instance_id JOIN erp_student st ON st.student_id = r.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code cd ON cd.gubun = 'S' AND cd.code = st.grade_key OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 session_id, status, entered_at, exited_at FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_session WHERE student_id = r.student_id AND session_date = si.service_date ORDER BY session_id DESC ) cs LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_diary dia ON dia.session_id = cs.session_id OUTER APPLY (
SELECT STUFF(( SELECT ',' + a.attitude_code FROM erp_bookstore_attitude a WHERE a.diary_key = dia.diary_key ORDER BY a.id FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '') AS attitudeCodes ) att WHERE si.service_date = #{date} AND si.center_code = #{centerCode} AND r.status = 'RESERVED'
AND COALESCE(dia.record_time, CAST(si.seq AS VARCHAR(2))) = #{timeSlot}
AND st.student_name LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%'
ORDER BY COALESCE(dia.record_time, CAST(si.seq AS VARCHAR(2))) ASC, st.student_name ASC

SELECT dia.student_id AS studentId, dd.content_id AS contentId, COALESCE(dd.book_name, c.original_title) AS bookTitle, COALESCE(dd.book_img, c.image_url) AS imageUrl, dd.read_minutes AS readMinutes, dd.basic_correct_cnt AS basicCorrectCount, dd.basic_total_cnt AS basicTotalCount, dd.advanced_correct_cnt AS advancedCorrectCount, dd.advanced_total_cnt AS advancedTotalCount, CAST(1 AS BIT) AS fromDiary, dd.id AS sortKey FROM erp_bookstore_diary dia JOIN erp_bookstore_diary_detail dd ON dd.diary_key = dia.diary_key JOIN erp_student st ON st.student_id = dia.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON c.content_id = dd.content_id WHERE dia.record_date = #{date} AND st.center_code = #{centerCode}
UNION ALL
SELECT rl.student_id AS studentId, rl.content_id AS contentId, c.original_title AS bookTitle, c.image_url AS imageUrl, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, rl.recommended_at, COALESCE(cs.quiz_started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AS readMinutes, rl.correct_count AS basicCorrectCount, rl.total_count AS basicTotalCount, adv.correctCount AS advancedCorrectCount, adv.totalCount AS advancedTotalCount, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS fromDiary, rl.recommend_id AS sortKey FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl JOIN erp_student st ON st.student_id = rl.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON c.content_id = rl.content_id OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 session_id, quiz_started_at FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_session WHERE student_id = rl.student_id AND session_date = #{date} ORDER BY session_id DESC ) cs OUTER APPLY ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correctCount FROM erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log q WHERE q.recommend_id = rl.recommend_id AND q.qlevel = '02' AND q.submitted_at = ( SELECT MAX(q2.submitted_at) FROM erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log q2 WHERE q2.recommend_id = rl.recommend_id AND q2.qlevel = '02' ) ) adv WHERE st.center_code = #{centerCode} AND CAST(rl.recommended_at AS DATE) = #{date} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_diary dia2 JOIN erp_bookstore_diary_detail dd2 ON dd2.diary_key = dia2.diary_key WHERE dia2.student_id = rl.student_id AND dia2.record_date = #{date} AND dd2.content_id = rl.content_id )
ORDER BY studentId ASC, fromDiary DESC, sortKey ASC
mapper.update: MERGE erp_bookstore_diary AS target USING ( SELECT cs.session_id, cs.student_id, cs.session_date, cs.entered_at, cs.exited_at, st.help_needed, (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(si.seq AS VARCHAR(2)) FROM erp_bookstore_reservation r JOIN erp_bookstore_slot_instance si ON si.slot_instance_id = r.slot_instance_id WHERE r.student_id = cs.student_id AND si.service_date = cs.session_date AND r.status = 'RESERVED' ORDER BY r.reservation_id DESC) AS time_slot FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_session cs JOIN erp_student st ON st.student_id = cs.student_id WHERE cs.session_id = #{sessionId} ) AS source ON target.session_id = source.session_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET memo = #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, created_by = #{createdBy}, updated_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (session_id, student_id, record_date, record_time, in_time, out_time, help_needed, memo, created_by) VALUES (source.session_id, source.student_id, source.session_date, source.time_slot, source.entered_at, source.exited_at, source.help_needed, #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdBy});

MERGE erp_bookstore_diary AS target USING ( SELECT cs.session_id, cs.student_id, cs.session_date, st.help_needed, (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(si.seq AS VARCHAR(2)) FROM erp_bookstore_reservation r JOIN erp_bookstore_slot_instance si ON si.slot_instance_id = r.slot_instance_id WHERE r.student_id = cs.student_id AND si.service_date = cs.session_date AND r.status = 'RESERVED' ORDER BY r.reservation_id DESC) AS time_slot, CASE WHEN NULLIF(#{inTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), cs.session_date, 23) + ' ' + #{inTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS DATETIME2) END AS in_time, CASE WHEN NULLIF(#{outTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), cs.session_date, 23) + ' ' + #{outTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS DATETIME2) END AS out_time FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_session cs JOIN erp_student st ON st.student_id = cs.student_id WHERE cs.session_id = #{sessionId} ) AS source ON target.session_id = source.session_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET in_time = source.in_time, out_time = source.out_time, updated_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (session_id, student_id, record_date, record_time, in_time, out_time, help_needed) VALUES (source.session_id, source.student_id, source.session_date, source.time_slot, source.in_time, source.out_time, source.help_needed);
mapper.select: SELECT dia.diary_key AS diaryKey, CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), dia.in_time, 108) AS inTime, CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), dia.out_time, 108) AS outTime FROM erp_bookstore_diary dia WHERE dia.session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT TOP 1 st.center_code FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_session cs JOIN erp_student st ON st.student_id = cs.student_id WHERE cs.session_id = #{sessionId}
